description: Sample AML monitoring scenarios for Vietnam, evaluated after each transaction of an account. Every rule that fires raises an alert for Case Management. Amounts in VND. CASH_STRUCTURING is set at the large-value reporting threshold of Decision 11/2023/QD-TTg (400,000,000 VND from 1 December 2023), to be confirmed against the official gazette; the other thresholds illustrate the typologies and are not legal thresholds

rules.description: Two or more cash deposits in 24 hours that together reach the large-value reporting threshold while each stays below it: splitting cash to avoid the report
rules.when: transaction.cash && transaction.direction == 'IN' && cashIn24h.count >= 2 && cashIn24h.amount >= money(400000000, 'VND') && cashIn24h.maxAmount < money(400000000, 'VND')

rules.description: 100,000,000 VND or more came in within 48 hours and 90% or more of it has already gone out: the account is used to pass money on
rules.when: transaction.direction == 'OUT' && in48h.amount >= money(100000000, 'VND') && has(flow48h.outToIn) && flow48h.outToIn >= decimal('0.9')

rules.description: Money from 10 or more different counterparties in 24 hours: the pattern of an account collecting for others
50,000,000 VND or more on an account with no activity for 180 days or more
